about_item: Bluetooth + MP3 Modes: The underwater headphones for swimming with Bluetooth 6.0 ensure an ultra-low transmission latency significantly enhances the music experience. Users can connect two or more devices. This allows for seamless switching between devices. OR listen to phone-free with internal MP3 storage for up to 4,000 songs. Easy to click twice to switch bluetooth and MP3 mode.

IPX8 Fearless for All-Weather Use: The waterproof bone conduction headphones has certified IPX8 waterproof rating and can be submerged in water up to two meters deep for one hour. Switch to MP3 mode, listening to favorite songs would make swimming and other underwater activities much more interesting. These open ear headphones feature fully sealed coating, no worry about underwater use.（Note: Please change the MP3 Mode when in water, bluetooth Mode cannot connect underwater.）

Open-Ear Comfort & Stable Wear: Stay alert with open ear bone conduction headphones that let you hear your surroundings, eliminating worries about missing out on crucial sounds. Soft, skin-friendly silicone cushions on the front of the ears guarantee a gentle touch and high fit, Open-ear designs allow for airflow, making them more comfortable to wear for extended periods. Product package includes an adjustable rope to accommodate different head sizes.

8 Hours of Music & Download: The waterproof headphones delivers up to 8 hours (Bluetooth Mode) of continuous listening life. With fast magnetic charging capability, you can achieve a full charge in just 2 hours. Connect the magnetic charging cable to the computer and headphones, you can read the USB built-in memory card, and copy the songs from the computer to the USB, then finish download the songs.

Outstanding Sound with Acoustic Drivers: True Bone conduction sports headphones equipped with 14mm speaker drivers for rich audio to enhance your listening experience. Conduction headphones built-in microphone with wireless bluetooth connectivity provides you a clear calling experience.
